page.overview:
What is B-7?

B-7 is the main antagonist of B7-2, the first story from Tales from the Pizzaplex 8: B7-2. It is a paranormal entity that was detached from the protagonist Billy after the events of B-7, the third story of Tales from the Pizzaplex 2: HAPPS.

B-7 is made up of everything removed from Billy, held together with wires and Billy’s own connective tissue and flesh. This includes tall dark-gray-metal-and-plastic prosthetic arms and right leg and black eyes. B-7 speaks with a damaged synthesizer that was previously in Billy's throat. It has a vaguely human-shaped metal-and-plastic head. Two of the plates that were put in Billy’s cheeks part as it speaks. B-7 bleeds blood and motor oil.

B-7 is an evil entity who wants to reattach himself with Billy or another human body at all costs.

B-7 is the animatronic name Billy gave himself sometime after his 19th birthday. He began to have body parts replaced or removed, replacing some with robotic parts to become more animatronic-like. At the end of the story Billy realizes what he had truly become and regrets everything, running away and hiding in a car in a junkyard. Billy wakes up with the car about to be destroyed.
